item.title: François Baranger returns to the abyss with an illustrated The Shadow over Innsmouth
item.description: Discover how Free League and François Baranger are recontextualising The Shadow over Innsmouth through the "Swedish Wave" of horror and cinematic art.

item.title: Pokémon Day 2026: A retail triumph for Forbidden Planet’s community hubs
item.description: Forbidden Planet reports record crowds for Pokémon Day 2026, but is it the official hub fans expect? We investigate the divide between retail hype and TCG reality.

item.title: Tales from the Tape Deck: The music-driven roleplaying game that fits in a cassette case
item.description: Suffety Games brings Tales from the Tape Deck to Kickstarter. This rules lite roleplaying game fits in a cassette case and uses a music playlist as a game timer.

item.title: Numenera: Strand short film returns as The Amber Archive eclipses original 2012 funding
item.description: The Ninth World returns in Numenera: The Amber Archive. Explore the mechanical shift to the Cypher System and the 10-year legacy of the stunning Strand short film.

item.title: Wizards of the Coast takes over The O2 for first official Dungeons & Dragons arena expo
item.description: Wizards of the Coast announces the first official Dungeons and Dragons Fan Expo at London's O2 Arena for August 2026 featuring the Baldur's Gate 3 cast.

item.title: The Asmodee era begins: Sirius Dice secures The Lord of the Rings licence
item.description: Sirius Dice announces a licensing partnership with Asmodee and Middle-earth Enterprises to release The Lord of the Rings tabletop accessories, including "blind-box" Treasure Packs and oversized d20s.

item.title: The Book of Masks: A 1920s Art Nouveau bestiary for roleplaying games
item.description: Arcane Canvas has launched The Book of Masks on Kickstarter. This trilogy of 1920s Art Nouveau hardcovers doubles as a system-neutral bestiary for roleplaying games.

item.title: D&D 5.5e is official: Has Wizards of the Coast just opened the door to 6th Edition?
item.description: Wizards of the Coast officially adopts the "5.5e" label for D&D 2024. Is this a marketing surrender or the first step toward D&D 6.0? Explore the 2026 roadmap featuring Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.

item.title: Check out the first trailer for The Handmaid’s Tale spinoff ‘The Testaments’
item.description: Hulu dropped an exciting first trailer for The Testaments earlier today, picking up the story five years after The Handmaid's Tale, and following a group of young women - including Hannah - in a disturbing coming-of-age tale.

item.title: Resistance mobilises: Modiphius announces official Wolfenstein roleplaying game
item.description: Modiphius announces Wolfenstein: The Tabletop Roleplaying Game. Join the resistance in a brutal alternate history using an updated 2d20 system.
